blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — A 56-year-old barangay kagawad from Asingan, Pangasinan, was killed after his motorcycle crashed into the gate of a residential property along the Urdaneta-Manaoag Road in Barangay San Vicente, Urdaneta City shortly after midnight on Thursday. Police identified the fatality as Dario Mapalo Dela Cruz, an incumbent barangay kagawad of Barangay Bobonan in Asingan. The victim was driving a white-and-black Yamaha Mio Gear motorcycle westbound at about 12:05 a.m. when he allegedly lost control of the motorcycle’s brakes, the police said.
